1.e4 c6 2.d4 Na6 3.Nc3.strategy: Develops the knight and guards e4 while Black's knight stands on the rim. White does not need to punish the slow move at once: sound development and a hold on the centre are enough to keep the better of the opening.

1.e4 c6 2.d4 Na6 3.Nc3 Nc7.strategy: Completes the knight's roundabout route: from c7 it supports a later push in the centre and covers d5 and e6. But it has taken two moves to develop one piece, and White is ahead in development and space.
1.e4 c6 2.d4 Na6 3.Nc3 Nc7.name: Caro–Kann Defence: De Bruycker Defence
